'''Biel Ductavis''' was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who led the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as its [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] at the end of the [[Pius Dea Crusades]], a series of conflicts that began in [[11,965 BBY]] and lasted for nearly one [[Time/Legends|millennium]]. When the Order suspended the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] following the [[Battle of Uquine|arrest]] of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Contispex XIX]] in [[10,966 BBY]], Ductavis was installed as the leader of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in an attempt to rebuild the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] government.

==Biography==
[[File:Jedi_symbol.svg|thumb|left|180px|Biel Ductavis served in the Jedi Order (emblem pictured).]]
Biel Ductavis was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="EGTW" /> He<ref name="Force" /> eventually achieved the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] during a [[Time/Legends|time]] known as the [[Pius Dea Era]]. Ductavis and<ref name="EGTW" /> his<ref name="Force" /> fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] remained on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] while the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellors]], who were [[Contispex dynasty|adherents]] of the [[Pius Dea]] religion, tore [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] asunder with the [[Pius Dea Crusades]], which were [[First Pius Dea Crusade|initiated]] in [[11,965 BBY]]. During the reign of Chancellor [[Contispex XIX]] nearly one millennium later, the Order had begun work with [[Caamasi/Legends|Caamasi]] peacekeepers in hopes of ending the oppression of the Pius Dea-controlled Republic.<ref name="EGTW" />

After [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of planning, the Order succeeded in overthrowing the Chancellor, [[Battle of Uquine|arresting]] Contispex aboard his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], ''[[Flame of Sinthara]]'', and suspending the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] in [[10,966 BBY]]. After Contispex was tried and [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] on the planet [[Caamas/Legends|Caamas]], the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] installed Ductavis in the [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Office of the Supreme Chancellor]]; Ductavis also served as the [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] of the Jedi Order during<ref name="EGTW" /> his<ref name="Force" /> tenure, leading both the Republic and the Jedi Order.<ref name="EGTW" /> During his lifetime, Ductavis created a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] that became known as the [[Ductavis Holocron]], and it was stored in the vaults beneath the [[Great Jedi Library/Legends|Great Jedi Library]] on Ossus after his eventual [[Death/Legends|death]]. However, when Ossus was evacuated prior to the [[Cron Supernova/Legends|Cron Supernova]] that destroyed the Library, the Jedi were unable to open the vault containing the Ductavis Holocron, so it and the vault were buried beneath rubble.<ref name="Force" />

==Personality and traits==
Biel Ductavis was trusted enough to lead both the Republic and the Jedi Order in the aftermath of the Pius Dea crusades.<ref name="EGTW" />

==Powers and abilities==
Ductavis was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] to the Force and eventually ascended to the rank of Jedi Master.<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Supreme Chancellor after the Pius Dea Crusades was first mentioned as part of a codex entry in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. That entry mentioned the individual was elected to the office of Supreme Chancellor,<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=codex|Galactic History 19: The Pius Dea Crusades}}</ref> before the character was named Biel Ductavis in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', a reference book written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]], and released in [[2012]]. In that book, it was mentioned Ductavis was installed by the High Council rather than elected.<ref name="EGTW" /> This article is written assuming that latter information is correct.
